name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.LastPass.thin_cross_rank_le
title: Cross-partition rank of a matrix whose first factor is a sum of K separable indicators is at most K t
statement: Over a field F, for f : Fin K -> X -> F, g : Fin K -> Y -> F, a : Fin K -> X -> Fin t -> F, b : Fin K -> Y -> Fin t -> F, the X x Y matrix with entries sum_k f k x * g k y * sum_i a k x i * b k y i has rank at most K * t.
